_doc: #1707 apps that were retired from the fleet and are no longer published. The Store keeps showing one, as RETIRED with an Uninstall action, for as long as a copy is still installed (StoreCloudFragment > Apps > Retired), so an installed copy never silently vanishes from the list. Once uninstalled it is gone from the page. `replacement_label` says where the function lives now.

apps.label: Cloud Writer
apps.reason: Merged into Cloud Keyboard: its Writer tab has every page of the former app. No update is published any more.
